seo.title: Valencia Dentistry | Dr. Nuriel Lavi, Santa Clarita
seo.description: Holistic, one-on-one dentistry in Valencia, Santa Clarita. Dr. Nuriel Lavi offers implants, veneers, Invisalign and same-day crowns. $59 new patient exam.

sections.heading: Dentistry that feels calm, personal and thorough.
sections.lead: Dr. Nuriel Lavi sees every patient himself, at every visit. Holistic, integrative care with modern technology, in a quiet office on Tourney Road.

sections.heading: Exceptional smiles. Only at Valencia Dentistry.
sections.lead: Dr. Lavi and the team are here to give you a smile you are genuinely proud of, done right the first time.

cards.title: Dentistry as artistry
cards.text: Dr. Lavi treats every smile like a custom project. The result is not just a better smile, it is one that actually looks like you.

image.alt: A bright, even smile after treatment

cards.title: Built to last
cards.text: We use the best materials available, with 3D imaging and guided planning, because your smile should still look great years from now.

image.alt: Dr. Nuriel Lavi treating a patient

cards.title: One of a kind
cards.text: Every plan is built around the person in the chair. No templates, no shortcuts, no handoffs, just work we are proud of.

image.alt: Smiling woman in a dental chair during a checkup

sections.heading: Modern dentistry, done with care
sections.text: Our mission is to protect the oral health and well-being of our community through comprehensive, compassionate and technically precise dental care, delivered by one dentist who knows you.

image.alt: Dentist examining a patient's teeth with a mirror

sections.heading: Precise diagnosis, gentler treatment
sections.lead: We invest in technology that makes care more accurate and more comfortable: clearer images, fewer visits and treatment that is planned before it begins.

image.alt: Dr. Nuriel Lavi, DDS next to a digital X-ray display

items.title: Digital X-rays
items.text: Detailed images with minimal radiation exposure, available instantly for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.text: See what we see. Clear close-up images make it easier to understand your options and track progress.

items.title: 3D imaging and cone beam CT
items.text: A three-dimensional view of teeth, bone and nerves for guided implant surgery, wisdom teeth and TMJ assessment.

items.title: Digital scanning and in-house crowns
items.text: iTero digital impressions instead of trays, and custom crowns designed and made on site, often the same day.

items.title: PRF therapy and laser dentistry
items.text: Platelet-rich fibrin from your own blood to support healing after surgery, and precise, gentle soft-tissue treatment with a laser.

sections.heading: Real results from our Valencia office
sections.lead: A few of the smiles restored here. Results vary from person to person.

sections.heading: Smile reimagined at Valencia Dentistry
sections.text: Dr. Lavi and the team bring together clinical excellence and genuine care, delivering smiles that look natural, feel right and last. New patients receive a comprehensive exam and X-rays for $59.

steps.title: Book your consultation
steps.text: Every great smile starts with a conversation. Dr. Lavi takes the time to understand what you want and maps out exactly how to get you there.

image.alt: Patient smiling during a dental cleaning

steps.title: Transform your smile
steps.text: Your smile should look like yours, just better. Every restoration is crafted to blend seamlessly, so no one can tell the difference except you.

image.alt: Smiling woman in a dental office

steps.title: Feel the difference
steps.text: Our relationship does not end when you leave the chair. From ongoing care to routine visits, we are your partner in keeping that smile for life.

sections.heading: In the heart of Valencia
sections.lead: Just off the I-5 on Tourney Road, minutes from Stevenson Ranch, Newhall, Saugus and Canyon Country.
